```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        YEAR(MIN(from_date)) AS start_year, 
        YEAR(MAX(CASE WHEN to_date < '9999-01-01' THEN to_date ELSE from_date END)) AS end_year 
    FROM dept_emp
), 
years AS (
    SELECT start_year AS yr 
    FROM bounds 
    UNION ALL 
    SELECT yr + 1 
    FROM years 
    CROSS JOIN bounds 
    WHERE yr < end_year
), 
snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        yr, 
        STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(yr, '-12-31'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS snapshot_date 
    FROM years
)
SELECT 
    s.yr AS year, 
    e.gender, 
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.emp_no) AS active_employees 
FROM snapshots s 
JOIN dept_emp d ON d.from_date <= s.snapshot_date AND d.to_date > s.snapshot_date 
JOIN employees e ON e.emp_no = d.emp_no 
GROUP BY s.yr, e.gender 
ORDER BY s.yr, e.gender;
```
